scope: Five TASK-050 research dossiers only; no production domain mutation is authorized.

status_definitions.existing_sufficient: An existing stable Component ID is precise enough for the modeled teaching role.
status_definitions.existing_but_broad: An existing Component is directionally relevant but collapses a source-significant role or technology distinction.
status_definitions.missing_required: The pilot cannot express a source-backed component or firmware-bearing role precisely with the current Component catalog.
status_definitions.optional_outside_scope: The role is real but per-instance detail is intentionally unnecessary for these Tickets.
status_definitions.rejected_unjustified: A nearby or plausible part was considered but neither source nor Ticket requires it.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: Fault-to-component relation exists for the input-cable Candidate; Symptoms should remain subsystem observations.
object_audit.tests_commands: Visual inspection and distribution isolation need a Ticket/profile-scoped observed path, not a global physical-nearness list.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: No selected Repair targets this cable; verification includes the complete path, so absence from a direct repair target is intentional.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: Selected PSU Faults already bind the component; no new Symptom relation is justified.
object_audit.tests_commands: Power-path tests already name the PSU where direct targeting is meaningful.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: The selected PDB Repair does not target the PSU; the distribution-path Verification already includes it.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: Board Fault relation is present. Boot and firmware Faults need path/control-surface semantics rather than being indiscriminately assigned to the whole board.
object_audit.tests_commands: Firmware compatibility already targets the board but lacks the queried firmware inventory/control-surface relation.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: Firmware verification already names the board; BMC recovery may escalate to the board FRU but must preserve the logical BMC target.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: The corrupt-firmware Fault resolves to BMC; responsiveness and update Symptoms should remain observations, not affected-component assertions.
object_audit.tests_commands: Recovery test has a BMC target; log review lacks its queried BMC control surface and observed subjects.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: Recovery and functional verification already target BMC. A recovery-image/control-surface relation remains missing.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: No selected hidden Fault targets the CPU; adding one would invent a Candidate.
object_audit.tests_commands: Minimum-configuration and stress relevance is profile-level dependency/load context, not a missing global target instance.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: No selected Repair or Verification directly targets CPU; relation intentionally absent.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: No selected hidden Fault is a DIMM Fault; public model inclusion supports alternative diagnostic relevance only.
object_audit.tests_commands: Existing memory tests have component semantics sufficient for this profile-level rationale.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: No selected memory Repair or Verification exists; relation intentionally absent.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: No selected hidden cooling Fault exists; no new Fault relation is justified.
object_audit.tests_commands: Cooling and thermal relevance is a documented bounded runtime path; exact fan-to-sensor instances remain profile data.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: No selected cooling intervention; relation intentionally absent.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: Backplane path Fault resolves to this role; missing-device/I/O Symptoms remain path observations.
object_audit.tests_commands: Inventory needs observed-path semantics across firmware/controller/OS rather than one direct component target.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: Cable reseat and storage verification need explicit endpoint/path relations; the backplane need not be the repair target itself.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: Generic cable Faults can affect this role, but the current catalog does not encode protocol/endpoints.
object_audit.tests_commands: Visual and inventory observations need the exact dossier path instance.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: Reseat and device-detected actions lack a typed repair-target/verified-path instance.

component_roles.role: PCIe/NVMe interconnect cable or connector branch

object_audit.faults_symptoms: A source-backed NVMe interconnect branch is required to keep cable and NVMe-device Candidates simultaneously plausible without misusing the SAS/SATA-only cable definition.
object_audit.tests_commands: Inventory, PCIe inventory, visual inspection, and NVMe commands observe different portions of this path.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: Reseat and detection need exact branch/endpoints; adding the Component alone is insufficient without typed relations.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: Controller Fault is already component-bound; the atlas limits it to the documented SAS branch.
object_audit.tests_commands: RAID status and firmware compatibility have suitable component relevance, though compatibility still needs a queried-inventory surface.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: No selected controller Repair; absence is intentional.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: NVMe device Fault relation is present; boot-device-not-detected still needs affected-path semantics.
object_audit.tests_commands: NVMe telemetry and inventories are relevant when reachable; no diagnostic result is inferred from presence.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: Replace NVMe and storage detection currently omit target Component/path instances and need enrichment.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: The fixed profile includes both SAS and SATA-capable bays; using only the SAS Component is an admitted pilot shorthand rather than a complete option inventory.
object_audit.tests_commands: Health actions need a selected device/path instance, not every installed drive.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: No selected SAS-drive Repair; relation intentionally absent.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: NIC Fault already binds the adapter; link Symptoms remain runtime observations.
object_audit.tests_commands: Network tests and firmware compatibility name the NIC where appropriate; counter observation additionally needs a runtime path.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: Firmware repair lacks explicit firmware-bearing targets; persistence verification already names the NIC but needs verified-state/path semantics.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: Both cable Candidates bind the role; no hidden state is carried by the profile.
object_audit.tests_commands: Substitution and soak require an observed host-NIC-to-peer path relation.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: No selected cable Repair; firmware verification includes link behavior but should verify the path rather than target the cable as changed.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: The broad game Fault can be privately bound to the exact PIB role for this profile, but a production profile needs an exact Component or typed realizes-role relation.
object_audit.tests_commands: Power isolation already targets the broad Component and PSU; profile path instances are still required.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: Repair and Verification relationships are present for the broad Component, but exact PIB service identity and containment/de-energization are not expressible.

object_audit.faults_symptoms: Boot-order and version-set Faults currently cannot name a firmware-bearing role or boot-policy control surface.
object_audit.tests_commands: Settings and compatibility reviews need a queried firmware/control-surface relationship.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: Restore-compatible-versions has no required Components; persistence verification names the board/BMC/NIC but cannot express the BIOS role itself.

component_roles.role: Grouped host loads, per-slot wiring, sensor buses, expanders, and exact connector pins

object_audit.faults_symptoms: No selected Candidate needs this detail.
object_audit.tests_commands: A grouped load/path is enough for the pilot's explanation.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: Creating IDs would add unsupported precision and no concrete action relationship.

component_roles.role: Universal tri-mode controller and exact R740xd power-distribution PCB

object_audit.faults_symptoms: Plausibility or visual proximity is not a Candidate/component proof.
object_audit.tests_commands: No exact pilot observation requires these inferred parts.
object_audit.repairs_verifications: No source-backed service target exists in the selected configuration; do not create an ID.

relationship_findings.need: The procedure's required_component_ids is empty even though the service action replaces the isolated NVMe unit.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: Domain enrichment only; does not authorize Repair or choose the target instance.

relationship_findings.need: One generic required-component list cannot identify the source-backed branch and its two endpoints without collapsing SAS and PCIe/NVMe paths.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: Profile-scoped enrichment; Ticket Isolation still selects the legal instance.

relationship_findings.need: The Verification describes firmware/controller/OS inventory and stable path identity but target_component_ids is empty and cannot express a layered verified path.
The Verification checks persistent boot policy and UEFI-to-loader handoff, but no BIOS/UEFI Component or boot-path relation exists.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: Domain enrichment only; success conditions and authored result remain authoritative.

relationship_findings.need: The Test requires a BMC console but target_component_ids is empty; a queried control surface and Ticket/profile-scoped observed subject are distinct relations.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: Does not imply a log outcome or decisive Evidence.

relationship_findings.need: The Test compares firmware, controller, and OS layers while target_component_ids is empty; one flat component list cannot preserve layer/path semantics.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: Observation scope only; Evidence rules remain authored.

relationship_findings.need: A global target list would incorrectly include every inspectable component; the concrete target belongs to the selected profile and Ticket action target.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: Requires profile/runtime target binding, not a broad domain edit.

relationship_findings.need: affected_component_ids is empty because the condition spans device, discovery path, and firmware inventory rather than one universally affected Component.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: Must not select which path is faulty or create a hidden root cause.

relationship_findings.need: affected_component_ids is empty and the incorrect state belongs to persistent UEFI boot policy, not a generic physical board failure.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: Domain enrichment only; Candidate truth remains Ticket-authored.

relationship_findings.need: Four target Components are present, but the Test actually queries version inventory across firmware-bearing roles and an approved baseline; physical target proximity alone is insufficient.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: Must not define compatibility tuples from topology.

relationship_findings.need: required_component_ids is empty; repair targets are a compatible set of firmware-bearing roles in an ordered change plan, not one undifferentiated component.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: The authored Repair remains the only change authority and compatibility source.

relationship_findings.need: Target Components exist, but the success conditions additionally require version persistence, completed jobs, driver initialization, and link/counter soak across lifecycle stages.
The BMC target is present, but reachability, reset, recovery-mode, external-media, and unrecoverable states are distinct observation/control paths.
The BMC requirement exists, but the recovery-image/bootloader path and conditional board-FRU escalation cannot be represented as typed dependencies.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: Must not turn board replacement into an automatically legal fallback.

relationship_findings.need: Action target lists are present for the key Test/Repair/Verification, but the domain cannot state input-to-PSU-to-PIB-to-board path order, redundancy peer relation, service containment, or de-energization dependency.
relationship_findings.gameplay_authority: Topology is explanatory and must not infer fault location or isolation acceptance.

relationship_findings.need: Public Symptoms can arise from multiple Candidate-compatible paths; assigning a Component would narrow or leak the diagnosis.
